card al-diff  [decided]
Every proposed change is a diff, never a before-and-after pair
why: Reviewing a change to a brief is much faster than reviewing a rewritten brief. A before section next to an after section is a rewrite in two pieces: the reader must compare them by eye.
subtree: 4 cards, 2 open, 2 decided

Also: reuse earlier artifacts so a failed gate does not restart elicitation from the beginning.

**The rule.** Every change to a card goes through the proposal command, as tagged edits to the existing text. The agent never writes a "before" section and an "after" section, in the card or in chat. The agent never sends a rewritten card as plain text. Eryk always sees one card with the changes marked inside it.

How a proposal looks is #al-diff-render.
